moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio count-up, written here): Number 48 px weight 850, tabular digits, right-aligned in a 104x56 window, % unit beside. In a 2.2 s loop it steps through every integer 0 → 100 linearly from 12 % to 70 % (0.26-1.54 s; recipe floor(progress × 100)); holds 100. Motion data: 1 s easeOutCubic. Params: from (0) · to (100) · duration (1.28 s) · suffix (%) · ease (none). Tabular digits, so the number does not shift sideways; right-align it in a fixed box.
